name: TICKER
rootCause: TICKER project developer steals $900,000. A developer brought on to run a presale for the TICKER token stole $900,000 from the project. 15% of the token supply was sent to the developer to distribute via an airdrop, but instead of doing so, the developer sold the majority of the tokens for around $900,000.
